title: Gene expression profile at single cell level of a rare seen and young tracheal adenoid cystic carcinoma
description: tracheal adenoid cystic carcinoma is one kind of non-small-cell lung cancer with limit treatment options. We used single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) to analyze the molecular characteristic of tracheal adenoid cystic carcinoma, aiming to recognized this disease deeply and provide potential treatment plan in the future. Overall design: Single cells obtained from the tumor tissue, the adjacent tissues, and blood were analyzed by RNA seq
